content.text: Summary: Read T-3001, inspected pods in ml-training, and found the new trainer pod stuck Pending with "Insufficient cpu" because it requests 16 vCPU while the m6i.2xlarge node pool only has 8 vCPU per node. Last week's job requested 6 vCPU and fit fine. Resolved the ticket with the cause, evidence, and two fixes (lower the CPU request, or add a larger node pool), citing the Kubernetes scheduling/resource-management docs.
